summary: Backend testing for Iter 216h50 features: Sites CSV template with invoice_customer_ref, Sites preview-csv with aliases, Sites CRUD with invoice_customer_ref, Equipment CSV template with site_name first + unit_price, Equipment bulk-import with site resolution and unit_price parsing. Found and fixed 1 bug in master-admin PATCH endpoint. All 15 tests pass.
seed_data_creation: Test organizations and sites created dynamically during tests via onboard-head-office endpoint with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter 216h50 backend features verified working. The master-admin PATCH endpoint was missing invoice_customer_ref support - this was fixed during testing.

tests: test_template_has_invoice_customer_ref_column - invoice_customer_ref is SECOND column after site_name
test_template_has_site_name_first_and_unit_price - site_name is FIRST column, unit_price present
test_import_equipment_with_site_name_resolution - Site resolved by name, site_id set
test_import_equipment_site_name_mismatch_error - Non-existent site returns error, row skipped
test_import_equipment_no_site_reference_allowed - No site ref imports with site_id=None

bug_fixed.issue: Master-admin PATCH endpoint (/api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/sites/{site_id}) did not support updating invoice_customer_ref field
bug_fixed.fix: Added 'invoice_customer_ref' to the list of updatable fields in admin_patch_org_site()

verified_data_storage.equipment_purchase_price: Populated from unit_price column (verified in DB: 3450 -> 3450.0, 3450.50 -> 3450.5, blank -> None)
verified_data_storage.equipment_replacement_cost: Populated from unit_price column (same as purchase_price)
verified_data_storage.equipment_site_id: Set correctly when site resolved by name or invoice_customer_ref, None when no site reference
